policies.h-low: Conservative: escalate only structural and evidence integrity failures.
policies.h-medium: Moderate and rule-based: residual integrity failures plus deterministic marking contradictions. No model-reported confidence.
policies.h-high: Aggressive: every deterministic contradiction plus model flags and any algebraic divergence from the printed answer.
